purpose: completion-pass re-run of the W2-b kernel benchmark by the Task-100 completion agent; the predecessor's measurements in results/w2-kernel.json are canonical and were NOT overwritten — this file records the re-run and the agreement analysis

rerun.command: HARNESS_COMMIT=6b6f5b477cb87d54ef2510b52ff21ccc10b4268d python3.12 python/w2_kernel_runner.py (full end-to-end: truck harness all-16, OCP bench all-16, both STEP cross-reads, CLI oracle 10, CLI timing N=5 x 16, isolated-process memory x 16 x 3 paths, packaging)

host.note: sandbox container (2-CPU, ~4 GiB cgroup; builds run with cargo -j 1)

rerun.runner_version_note: the in-tree runner now also assembles summary.step_interop and flags STEP cross-read volume anomalies in failures; the predecessor envelope predates that detection — the underlying st5 numbers are IDENTICAL in both envelopes, only the flagging is new

isolated_single_case_reruns.note: each in its own OS process, compared to the predecessor's per-case records

truck_direct_api.agreement: volumes BITWISE identical on all 7 (k13 45569.184328643234, k07 23340.451754853464, k08 23730.666666666668, k09 13632.0, k01 24000.0, st5 8377.430624981922); st1 refusal error text VERBATIM identical; face counts identical; STEP round-trip rel deltas identical to the last digit on k01/k07/k08/k09/k13

ocp.agreement: volumes BITWISE identical on all 7 (k13 45571.68026350791, k07 23340.84937505542, k08 23730.666666666664, k09 13631.999999999993, k01 24000.0, st5 8377.578837898305); st1 refusal VERBATIM identical ('fillet r=200.0: IsDone() is false'); validity flags identical

cli_oracle.agreement: k13: pass=true, 8/8 checks, volume 45569.24859969774 (tessellated CLI measure, same tolerance class as predecessor's pass)

agreement_analysis.method: leaf-by-leaf diff of the two envelopes (python json walk, 9,322 predecessor leaves)
agreement_analysis.verdict: REPRODUCED: every outcome, volume, error text, face count, comparability label, and STEP cross-read volume in the predecessor envelope re-appeared in the re-run; differences are confined to wall-clock timings, allocator peak-RSS noise (max ~6% relative, e.g. st5 truck 716736 -> 761264 KiB, same order), 9 last-ULP float diffs in STEP cross-read measures (rel < 1e-9), and ASLR addresses in ldd output

fixtures.set: kernel benchmark shared fixtures (experiment C, Task 100)
fixtures.selection_note: 16 fixtures: 10 derived from upstream tests/oracle (provenance per case: upstream path + recipe SHA + license; expected values copied verbatim from upstream expected.json) and 6 self-authored (author/date stated; analytic expectations self-derived and shown in 'method'). The SAME parts are re-implemented twice: truck-side in harness/src/bin/w2_kernel.rs (direct kernel API, pinned SHA) and OCP-side in python/ocp_kernel_bench.py (cadquery-ocp 8.0.1.1.0 wheels in .ocp-venv).

tolerance.note: same defaults as upstream's oracle runner (REL_TOL 1e-3); truck measures tessellated geometry, OCCT integrates surfaces

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/01-box/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: comparable
comparability.why: planar box; both kernels judged against the closed-form V=abc, A=2(ab+bc+ca)

expected.method: box 40 x 30 x 20 from the origin: V = abc, A = 2(ab + bc + ca)

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/02-cylinder/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: comparable
comparability.why: analytic cylinder; truck measures through tessellation (upstream tolerance 1e-3 rel), OCCT integrates B-rep surfaces exactly

expected.method: cylinder r=15 h=50 on XY: V = pi r^2 h, A = 2 pi r^2 + 2 pi r h

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/04-revolve-vase/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: same profile revolved 360 deg; kernels split the periodic surface at their own seams, so face counts and area can differ slightly while volume is judged against Pappus

expected.method: revolve of a line/3-point-arc profile (XZ, x = radius, z = -sketch y) 360 deg about Z. Pappus/Green: V = 2 pi * int x dA, z_c = int x z dA / int x dA, A = sum over profile edges of 2 pi int x ds (bottom disk r20, frustum r20->25, torus zone of the arc (centre (-16.000000, 33.000000), R=41.109610), frustum r15->18, top disk r18)

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/07-fillet-all-edges/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: rolling-ball corners differ BY DESIGN between kernels (upstream oracle.md records FreeCAD/OCCT building different corner patches); volume/area judged against the same Steiner formula

expected.method: box 40x30x20 with every edge rounded r=3 = inner box (34x24x14) grown by a ball r (Steiner): V = abc + 2r(ab+bc+ca) + pi r^2 (a+b+c) + 4/3 pi r^3, A = 2(ab+bc+ca) + 2 pi r (a+b+c) + 4 pi r^2; faces 6 planes + 12 quarter cylinders + 8 sphere octants

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/08-chamfer/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: symmetric chamfers meeting at corners can be mitered differently; totals judged against the exact polynomial integration

expected.method: box 40x30x20 with the 4 top edges chamfered 2: lower box 40x30x18 + top slab with section (36+2u)x(26+2u) at depth u (V, moment by exact polynomial integration); A = bottom + sides(h=18) + top 36x26 + 4 trapezoid bevels of slant 2 sqrt2

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/09-shell/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: truck shell (polyhedron::shell) and OCCT BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid are different algorithms; this convex open-top case has the same analytic cavity, general shell semantics are NOT equivalent

expected.method: 50x40x30 box shelled inward 2 with the top open: box minus cavity [2,48]x[2,38]x[2,30]; A = outer bottom + outer sides + rim + cavity floor + cavity walls

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/13-combine-join/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: comparable
comparability.why: box-cylinder union with analytic totals; both kernels judged independently against the closed form

expected.method: box [0,40]^2x[0,20] union cylinder r=12 at (40,20) z 0..40: V = box + half-cylinder (x>40, z<20, centroid 40 + 4r/3pi) + full cylinder z 20..40; A = bottom (1600 + pi r^2/2) + box top (1600 - pi r^2/2) + cyl top + 3 full sides + x=40 side minus 24x20 + cyl side (pi r 40 outside half + pi r 20 upper inside half)

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/14-combine-cut/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: comparable
comparability.why: box minus lower hemisphere with analytic totals (V = abc - 2/3 pi r^3)

expected.method: box [-25,25]^2x[-20,0] minus sphere r=15 at the origin (lower hemisphere removed): V = abc - 2/3 pi r^3, hemisphere centroid z = -3r/8; A = 2(ab+bc+ca) - pi r^2 + 2 pi r^2

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/15-combine-intersect/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: comparable
comparability.why: cube-sphere intersection, caps provably disjoint, analytic totals

expected.method: cube [-20,20]^3 intersect sphere R=25: sphere minus 6 disjoint caps of height h=5 (caps cannot overlap: two would need x^2+y^2 > 800 > R^2); V = 4/3 pi R^3 - 6 pi h^2 (3R-h)/3, A = 4 pi R^2 - 6 * 2 pi R h + 6 pi (R^2-20^2)

provenance.cli_script_note: generated by the official release binary: solidcraft-cli recipe tests/oracle/38-coincident-cylinders/recipe.json (tag v0.16.2 = 5de48e9, 80 commits behind the pin)

comparability.label: comparable
comparability.why: union of coaxial same-radius cylinders sharing lateral faces; analytic result is one r10 h50 cylinder; doubles as a coincident-face robustness probe

expected.method: union of r10 z0..30 and r10 z20..50 = cylinder r10 h50: V = pi r^2 h, A = 2 pi r h + 2 pi r^2

provenance.author: W2 lane-b kernel-benchmark worker (Task 100)
provenance.derived_from: same box parametrization as oracle 07 (tests/oracle/07-fillet-all-edges), subset of its edge set

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: straight-edge constant-radius subset (no corner patches where three blends meet): both kernels roll the same cylinder on the same edges; only end-cap trimming can differ

expected.method: box 40x30x20, fillet r=3 on the 4 vertical edges: cross-section = ab - (4-pi) r^2; V = cross*h; A = 2*cross + (2((a-2r)+(b-2r)) + 2 pi r) h

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: failure probe: fillet radius far larger than the geometry allows; a clear refusal is an honest outcome, recorded verbatim per kernel

expected.note: no analytic volume: the case must not build; record each kernel's outcome class and verbatim error
expected.method: stress case (author: W2 lane-b, 2026-10-20): fillet r=200 on box 40x30x20 all 12 edges (oracle 07 box)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: near-tangency + body-split probe: cylinder wall pokes through two box faces by 0.0001 mm AND spans the full y-range, splitting the box into two lumps; totals judged analytically

expected.note: the r=5.0001 disk at (10,5) spans the box's full y-range [0,10] (poking through BOTH side faces by 0.0001 mm), so the cut SPLITS the box into two lumps (7 faces each, 14 total); each lump is near-tangent-trimmed on its inner face. Volume is the total over both lumps. Observed on truck first (shells=2), analytic confirmed after: no connection between the lumps at any y since the disk covers x in [10-sqrt(r^2-(y-5)^2), 10+sqrt(r^2-(y-5)^2)] with sqrt >= 0.0316 > 0 at y=0,10.
expected.method: box 20x10x10 cut cylinder r=5.0001 axis z at (10,5) spanning z -5..15: V = 2000 - 10*(pi r^2 - 2*seg), seg = r^2 acos(5/r) - 5*sqrt(r^2-25) (chord 5 from the axis)

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
comparability.why: sliver probe: 50 x 0.02 profile (aspect 2500:1) extruded 10 mm; both kernels must hold V = 10 exactly

expected.method: rectangle 50 x 0.02 extruded 10: V = a*b*c; A = 2*ab + 2(a+b)*c

comparability.label: approximately-comparable
